title: Kaplan Fox Urges EquipmentShare.Com Inc (NASDAQ: EQPT) Investors to Contact the Firm Before the Deadline on September 21, 2026
author: Kaplan Fox & Kilsheimer Llp
description: A class action lawsuit has been filed against EquipmentShare.Com Inc on behalf of investors who purchased stock during its IPO in January 2026 or through June 2026. The lawsuit was triggered by a June 24, 2026 report alleging undisclosed related party transactions that netted EquipmentShare founders at least $77 million. Following the report, the company's stock price fell 6.62% on June 24 and declined an additional 11.7% the next trading day.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company faces a class action lawsuit alleging undisclosed related party transactions benefiting founders. The allegations triggered significant stock price declines of approximately 18% over two trading days, indicating serious investor concerns about corporate governance and transparency issues.

title: ROSEN, LEADING INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages EquipmentShare.com Inc Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - EQPT
author: Rosen Law Firm
description: Rosen Law Firm is urging investors who purchased EquipmentShare.com Inc securities during its January 2026 IPO or between January 23 and June 23, 2026 to join a securities class action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that EquipmentShare made materially false statements and failed to disclose undisclosed related party transactions with entities owned by co-founders, resulting in misleading financial statements. The lead plaintiff deadline is September 21, 2026.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company is the subject of a securities class action lawsuit alleging material misstatements, undisclosed related party transactions with co-founder entities, and misleading financial statements. These allegations indicate serious governance and disclosure failures that harmed investors.

title: ROSEN, NATIONAL TRIAL LAWYERS, Encourages Park Ha Biological Technology Co., Ltd. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - PHH, BYAH
author: Rosen Law Firm
description: Rosen Law Firm has filed class action lawsuits against Park Ha Biological Technology Co., Ltd. (NASDAQ: PHH, BYAH) on behalf of investors who purchased securities between December 27, 2024 and July 8, 2025. The lawsuit alleges that defendants made materially false statements and failed to disclose a fraudulent stock promotion scheme involving social media misinformation, artificially low public float, and manipulated trading activity. The deadline to serve as lead plaintiff is September 28, 2026.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company is mentioned as the subject of another securities class action investigation by Rosen Law Firm, indicating potential securities violations and investor losses.

The company is the subject of a securities class action lawsuit alleging fraudulent stock promotion schemes, false statements, misleading disclosures, and intentional market manipulation through artificially low public float structure.

title: Lowey Dannenberg, P.C. is Investigating EquipmentShare.com Inc. (NASDAQ: EQPT) for Potential Violations of the Federal Securities Laws
author: Lowey Dannenberg P.C.
description: Law firm Lowey Dannenberg is investigating EquipmentShare.com Inc.
